1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant seeking direction to
Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.2, Gorakhpur to decide the Criminal Case
No.23941 of 2022 (State v. Rituraj Tripathi and others) arising out of Case Crime No.208 of 2020,
under Sections 498A & 323 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Shahpur, District
Gorakhpur (U.P.), within stipulated period.
Geeta Tripathi vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 12 November, 2024

sentences.text: Considering the fact that the aforesaid case is pending since 2020.

Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court below to decide the aforesaid case in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, if there is no other legal impediment.
